title: A MAKER pipeline for prediction of protein-coding genes in parasitic worm genomes
protocol: Generate a repeat library for the genome of interest using RepeatModeler.
Mask repetitive elements in the genome using RepeatMasker by scanning scaffolds for matches to the repeats in the repeat library.
Train SNAP using CEGMA gene models for KOGs, as well as NOGs, TROGs, or CEOGs.
For the second MAKER run, train SNAP using the MAKER gene models obtained from the first MAKER run.
For the third MAKER run, train Augustus using the MAKER gene models obtained from the second MAKER run.
Generate _ab initio_ gene models using Augustus, GeneMark-ES 2.3a, and SNAP.
Generate further gene models using comparative algorithms genBlastG and RATT.
Align species-specific ESTs and cDNAs from INSDC against the genomes using BLASTN.
Align proteins from related species against the genomes using BLASTX.

Integrate and filter EST and protein homology alignments, comparative gene models, and _ab initio_ gene predictions using MAKER to produce a gene set for the species, ensuring one transcript per gene.
Discard any MAKER gene models based on exonerate or BLASTX alignments that do not overlap with Augustus, genBlastG, or RATT gene models.
Remove MAKER gene models encoding proteins shorter than 30 amino acids.
If two different MAKER gene models overlap in coding sequence, discard the model with the worse AED score.
